## Changes

### Fixes
- Covers that stayed blank load again: Comix's (the site now gives covers as paths, which the app resolves against the source; ones already saved in Bookmarks, History and Downloads are fixed when the app starts) and MangaDex's (its image host turned away the app's browser User-Agent with a bot check). A cover that failed is downloaded again the next time it shows.
- Reading on to a chapter the source added after the series page loaded now adds it to that page's chapter list, without a pull to refresh.
